notes: BSX's side of Component Upgrades (stage U1). A family is a Void Salvage slot unit BSX builds at tiers; an add-on is a BSX-only part fitted inside it on one of the unit's internal mount points.

Base figures are Void Salvage's BaseShip exports as built (attract_max_mass 8000 kg, attract_reach 18 m, attract_speed 5 m/s, attract_accel 14 m/s2). A tier's figures replace the base; an add-on adds its tier's amount to a figure.
A unit holds at most max_addons add-ons, one per mount point; an add-on's tier can't be above its unit's tier. Tier 3 needs no special bay in U1 (the heat exchanger rule is U2).

quantum_core.blurb: A sealed cylinder that grows in diameter per tier; it widens the beam's field and lets it hold more.

field_emitter.blurb: Extra emitter horns on the coil housing: the beam reaches further and pulls faster.

control_board.blurb: BSX firmware, wired in: it unlocks the tier and holds the certificate. Every upgraded unit has one.
